sections.title: U.S. Senate
summary: On October 29, 2026, Senate Bill S 675, known as Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library Act, was placed on the Union Calendar, Calendar No. 763.
This action indicates the bill's first step toward a potential vote in the Senate.
The Senate action reflects the institution's attention to the proposed legislation.
As of the summary's date, the status of the bill remains pending in the Senate.
The bill's progress is subject to change as it undergoes further review and voting.
